task: approach an actual RGB-detected brick within 0.35m of robot base, then return and dock
variation: brick position, color, size and yaw
teacher: Privileged physical route planner, 0.24m brick standoff allowing for 0.10m arrival tolerance inside the 0.35m acceptance radius, actual RGB needed for consumption, original box docking criteria
studentInputs: TCP RGB84x84, own feedback7, recurrent state128; no oracle, map, pose or event hints
format: PVDATA03; oracle targets separate from executed commands
acceptance: All128 scenes complete and every RGB input, feedback value, oracle label, student command, physical tick, proximity event and docking pose independently verified
failurePolicy: Preserve failures; stop publication, repair and retry the same scene identities rather than drop cases
limitations: Eight layout instances from two families, not arbitrary houses. Teacher-assisted collection success is not student benchmark performance.
